findings.evidence: OrderEntity and OrderItemEntity store purchase/order history locally in the Room SQLite database via PosDao.processSaleAtomic and PosRepository.processCheckoutAtomic. No off-device network transfer or third-party egress exists for purchase history.
findings.recommendation: No action required as purchase history remains stored locally on-device.

findings.evidence: The keyword 'record' in the specified files refers to recording financial transactions (recordCustomerPayment, RecordPaymentSheet), not audio or voice recording. No audio data or recording APIs exist in the codebase.
findings.recommendation: No action required as no audio data is collected or transmitted.

findings.evidence: Pattern 'race' matched method names (e.g., printStackTrace). No race or ethnicity data is collected or transferred.
Pattern 'loadUrl' matched APK download URL variables (downloadUrl). No user web browsing history is collected or transmitted off-device.

Camera hardware permission is requested exclusively for real-time barcode/QR code scanning using ML Kit. Camera frames are processed on-device and discarded without off-device transmission or storage.

AuthViewModel.kt uses Firebase Auth (signInWithEmailAndPassword / createUserWithEmailAndPassword) to authenticate users using their email address when initiated by the user in EmailAuthScreen.kt. CustomersScreen.kt manages customer email addresses locally in Room DB.
findings.recommendation: Declare EMAIL collection in the Play Store Data Safety section under App functionality / Account management, linked to the user account.

findings.evidence: User authentication credentials and account identifiers (Google ID token, email/password credentials) are sent to Firebase Auth during user-initiated authentication in WelcomeScreen.kt and EmailAuthScreen.kt. PinLockScreen.kt authenticates PINs locally against Room DB.
findings.recommendation: Declare USER_ACCOUNT collection in the Play Store Data Safety section under App functionality / Account management.

findings.evidence: Financial information including sales income, expenses, cash shift balances, and customer debts are stored and processed exclusively in the local Room database (PosDatabase) and are not transmitted off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required for Play Store Data Safety declaration as financial data remains on-device only.

findings.evidence: In ReportsScreen.kt line 192, 'trackColor' is a parameter for Material 3 LinearProgressIndicator UI styling, not user music files. No music data is collected or transferred.
findings.recommendation: No action required. The 'track' pattern is a false positive matching a Compose progress indicator property.

findings.evidence: TicketReceiptModal.kt uses Intent.ACTION_SEND with text/plain and Intent.ACTION_VIEW with application/pdf via PdfReceiptGenerator.kt when the user explicitly clicks the Share or PDF buttons to export/open receipt files.
findings.recommendation: Manual sharing triggered by user action via Android Share Sheet is policy exempt from prominent disclosure requirements. Ensure Play Store Data Safety section reflects app document export functionality if required.

findings.issue_summary: App implements a login and authentication interface requiring reviewer credentials and account deletion URL in Play Console.
findings.evidence: WelcomeScreen.kt and EmailAuthScreen.kt display authentication screens, and AuthViewModel.kt handles Firebase Auth email/password login/registration and Google Sign-In.
findings.recommendation:
Administrative Console Requirements: Because your app implements a login flow, you MUST complete two manual setup steps in the Play Console dashboard to pass review:
1. Reviewer Demo Credentials: Submit active, non-expiring test credentials so Google Play reviewers can access your gated features.
2. Account Deletion Link: Submit a public-facing web link for account deletion to satisfy Google Play's data deletion policies.

findings.issue_summary: App manages user accounts but does not provide an in-app account deletion mechanism.
findings.evidence: AuthViewModel.kt and SettingsScreen.kt provide logout functionality (auth.signOut()), but lack any feature, UI control, or API integration for users to delete their account or request backend data erasure.
findings.recommendation: Implement in-app deletion: Create a highly discoverable path (e.g., under User Profile/Account Settings) to let users initiate account deletion directly in the app.
